name: Shadcn Hooks
summary: Collection of 58 TypeScript-first React hooks built in the shadcn style, installed via the shadcn CLI or as an npm package.
description: A collection of 58 React hooks plus three lib utilities (createContext, createEffectWithTarget, isBrowser), grouped into state, lifecycle & effects, browser, dev and external-library categories. The hooks are TypeScript-first, SSR compatible and built for React 19+, and install either as shadcn registry items via the shadcn CLI or all at once from npm. The docs site documents every hook and ships an AI Skills directory (SKILL.md plus per-hook references) that teaches coding assistants like Cursor and Codex how to use each hook.
contains: 58 React hooks and 3 lib utilities (createContext, createEffectWithTarget, isBrowser)
categories: state, lifecycle & effects, browser, dev, external libraries
install via shadcn CLI registry items or as one npm package
AI Skills directory with SKILL.md and per-hook reference files for coding assistants
TypeScript-first, SSR compatible, built for React 19
hook docs with demos, e.g. useBoolean, useDebounce, useInterval, useClipboard, useFps
hooks include useQuery, useSWR, useMcp and useStickToBottom for chat UIs
